notes.title: Update/Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked the Industry level
[*] Reworked aim level
[*] Reworked blood decals now they are not duplicated.
[*] Fixed collisions when the player could not kill the enemy behind some obstacles such as the grid.
[*] Fixed saving and loading levels.
[*] Fixed UI information and quest now it is displayed correctly.
[*] Added transition to a new level immediately from the level you finished.[/b]

notes.title: FIX BUG #2
notes.content:
Fixed a bug with the AI on the map DUST now they walk normally.
Fixed bug with the opening of the last level.
Fixed a bug with the registration of hits, now when you hit the body or arm it does not count as a headshot.
Added sound of using first aid kit.
